title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
description: You are given an array prices where prices[i] is the price of a given stock on the ith day. You want to maximize your profit by choosing a single day to buy one stock and choosing a different day in the future to sell that stock. Return the maximum profit you can achieve from this transaction. If you cannot achieve any profit, return 0.

examples.explanation: Buy on day 2 (price=1), sell on day 5 (price=6), profit=5.

hints: Think about tracking the minimum price seen so far.
At each step, calculate if selling today gives max profit.

optimalSolution.approach: Single pass. Track minimum price seen so far (minPrice) and maximum profit (maxProfit). For each price, update maxProfit = max(maxProfit, price - minPrice), then update minPrice.

followUpQuestions: What if you can complete at most 2 transactions? (LC-123)
What if you can complete as many transactions as you like? (LC-122)
interviewerNotes: Greedy problem that tests if candidate can identify optimal substructure. Look for O(n) single-pass approach. Great follow-up: what if we allow multiple buy/sell?
